title: Quiz Format Notes
description: How quiz formats change a game: multiple choice or typed answers, everyone answers or a race, rounds and timing. Notes by Ahmed Moaz.
blurb: The same questions can make a tense quiz or a dull one depending on the format. These notes compare the choices a quiz maker has: answer types, scoring, rounds and the clock.
about: I am Ahmed Moaz. I build Boardit, a small site of free browser games that includes a trivia quiz.
This blog compares quiz formats: what multiple choice does that typed answers cannot, why everyone-answers scoring changes who wins, and how long a round should be.
